invariant: ADR-0162 Execution item 7: the engine hands every run of a tree, to any depth, its root run (id, flow key, the object of its record, start), stamped on the run's own context under a string key so it survives a suspension's JSON round trip. A run with no parent is its own root whatever the caller's context carried; a child keeps its parent's and is never stamped as a root. A run parked before the stamp derives its root from its $parentRunId links when resumed, through the STRICT loader, so a parent the store cannot read refuses the resume before the claim instead of recording no root.
